gui.equipment_affix.status.not_affixed: No affixes yet - insert in the Upgrade Table
tooltip.equipment_affix.breakthrough: Breakthrough available at the Upgrade Table
tooltip.equipment_affix.hint: Crafted gear starts with 3 affixes; loot can have more.
jei.equipment_affix.upgrade.1: Normal upgrade: 1 amethyst shard + XP per level; levels 0 -> 20.
jei.equipment_affix.upgrade.2: XP cost: ceil(6 x 1.14^level); 7 levels at level 0, 73 at level 19.
jei.equipment_affix.upgrade.4: Breakthrough materials, in order: 8 amethyst shards, 1 diamond, 1 netherite scrap, 1 echo shard, 1 nether star.
jei.equipment_affix.upgrade.5: Initialization: insert un-affixed gear; 1 amethyst shard + 3 XP levels gives 3 tier-1 affixes.
jei.equipment_affix.upgrade.6: One-key upgrade: repeatedly upgrades up to (but not through) the next breakthrough.
jei.equipment_affix.reforge.2: Keeps level, rarity, affix count and total tier sum; rerolls affix types and tier distribution.
jei.equipment_affix.amethyst.1: Amethyst shard: 1 per normal upgrade; 1 to initialize; 8 for the first breakthrough.
jei.equipment_affix.netherite_scrap.1: Netherite scrap: 1 for the third breakthrough (11 -> 12).
jei.equipment_affix.echo_shard.1: Echo shard: 1 for the fourth breakthrough (15 -> 16); 1 to reforge.
jei.equipment_affix.nether_star.1: Nether star: 1 for the fifth breakthrough (19 -> 20).
jei.equipment_affix.smithing_table.1: Smithing table: core crafting material for both tables.
jei.equipment_affix.equipment.2: Crafted gear starts with 3 common affixes; loot scales with rarity.
advancements.equipment_affix.root.title: Path of Affixes
advancements.equipment_affix.root.descri: Obtain an Affix Upgrade Table and start forging your gear.
advancements.equipment_affix.first_affix: Give an item its first affixes at the Upgrade Table.
advancements.equipment_affix.first_upgra: Upgrade an affixed item to level 1.
advancements.equipment_affix.max_level.d: Bring an item's affix level to 20.
